csv_project_name: Engineering Svc CTH K Lynndale Rd -Brookfield Rd
csv_scope_of_work: The Waukesha County Department of Public Works ( the Sponsor ) is interested in obtaining the services of an engineering/design consulting firm ( the Consultant ) for the facility development process. The process will result in the design and preparation of preliminary and final plans, PS&E documents, and reports, for the modernization and expansion of the CTH K Corridor between CTH JK and Brookfield Road in the Villages of Sussex, Lisbon, Menomonee Falls and the City of Brookfield ( the Project ). Waukesha County has received federal funding approval for Phase 1 (Executive Drive to Sussex Creek) of the corridor expansion and modernization. The county has applied for a federal BUILD grant for Phase 2A (Quarry Corners Parkway to Roberta Drive) of the corridor expansion and modernization.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, ITS Design, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning

title: Engineering Services for CTH K Lynndale Road - Brookfield Road
short_description: Design services for corridor expansion and modernization of County Trunk Highway K in Wisconsin.
project_location: Pewaukee, Waukesha County, Wisconsin, USA; corridor between CTH JK and Brookfield Road in Sussex, Lisbon, Menomonee Falls, and Brookfield.
project_scope: Facility development, modernization, and expansion of the CTH K corridor between CTH JK and Brookfield Road. The project includes Phase 1 from Executive Drive to Sussex Creek with federal funding approval and proposed Phase 2A from Quarry Corners Parkway to Roberta Drive under a BUILD grant application. No bridge spans, structural dimensions, or building areas are stated.
services: Engineering/design consulting services for preliminary and final design, preparation of plans, specifications and estimates (PS&E), and reports. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, ITS design, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway corridor expansion and modernization project, not a bridge or special structure.
- Requested services focus on civil, traffic, environmental, and planning disciplines rather than structural engineering for notable load-bearing structures.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding structure is described.
- Includes project management and transportation planning components, which are generally low relevance for sbp.
- Could involve incidental structures, but none are specified in the notice.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice mentions federal funding approval for Phase 1 and a BUILD grant application for Phase 2A, but provides no budget, length, quantities, or unit-cost basis for a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No design fee or fee basis is stated. The scope covers multi-disciplinary corridor design through preliminary and final plans and PS&E, but there is insufficient cost information to derive a reliable sbp fee estimate.
references_qualifications: No explicit reference requirements are stated in the source. The consultant is expected to provide capabilities in civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, ITS design, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning.
